- Review Social Security claiming assumptions (estimated $3,050 per month at full retirement age) and pension options (no pension).
- Identify taxable, tax-deferred, and Roth account balances available for withdrawals (401(k) about $710,000, Roth IRA about $94,000, rollover IRA about $156,000, taxable brokerage about $542,000).
- Estimate sustainable withdrawal range under base, cautious, and stress scenarios.

- Identify healthcare, Medicare, long-term care, and insurance considerations (HSA about $18,000, long-term disability replacing 60% of eligible salary).
- Document recommended income sources for the next planning period.
- List open items, assumptions, and follow-up decisions for the client.
